comment: The background lane's scored set: the measured footage index plus conditions asked for at hours and in
months the index does not cover. Every entry is in the same form as the index's own render clips (the 15th
of the month, 40 s since the start, 10 s, 1920 x 1080, seed 1, colour 0), so the numbers are comparable
with the index's. scoreset.py resolves each one to a clip of the requested footage index and writes one
index file for battery.py --index and bgfit/prep.py --index.
Groups: 'shoulder' = hours between the four tuning hours, in the months the index covers; 'month' = the
tuning hours in the eight months the index does not cover; 'month-shoulder' = hours between them there.
